Learn prompting properly, then make AI portraits and scroll-stopping thumbnails with the design workflows taught live (Canva, Canva AI).
Produce short videos and AI avatars, and run advanced workflows across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Muse AI and Google Flow.

Create and list a digital product on Etsy, launch an AI-built website, use Python for automation, and pitch clients on Fiverr and Upwork.

About SkillX

A free institute for AI & digital skills

Built in Pakistan for students everywhere — structured like an online university: courses, faculty, live classes, exams and certificates.

What SkillX is

SkillX is a digital institute of technology founded by Najeeb Ullah and Mian Haroon. Classes are taught live by working specialists, students learn by building real projects, ask questions in class, get assignments reviewed, and earn a verifiable achievement certificate — without paying anything.

SkillX is based in Shahpur Chakar, Sindh, Pakistan.

Our mission

Practical, career-building skills education should be free, live and reachable for everyone.

That is why SkillX classes are taught live every night by working specialists — not left as lonely recordings.

The AI Pro Course

SkillX AI Pro is a 100% free course in AI and digital skills. It runs for four weeks, from 5 Oct to 2 Nov 2026, with live classes every night at 8:30 PM PKT on Zoom. Najeeb Ullah and Mian Haroon host every session, and specialist mentors join for expert classes in their own fields. Students complete weekly assignments and earn an achievement certificate.
